newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish air carrier LOT to cut weekend price.
newsitem.headline: Polish air carrier LOT to cut weekend price.

text.p: Poland's national airlines PLL LOT SA will lower the price of its weekend European flights to an average of 10 percent below the lowest regular APEX tariff, LOT's press office said.
It said the special promotional prices will be in place from January 10 to March 15.
"Passengers may take advantage of the special offer if they leave on a Friday or Saturday staying over to Sunday but no longer than four days," the press office said in a statement.
LOT said children would receive an additional 33 percent price reduction.
The special offer does not apply to any other routes apart from European flights.
